ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface relative to low-frequency high-intensity (white) pixels localized in scars and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-intensity white pixels form diffuse, non-geometric mottling clusters on the interior right lobe and a series of thin linear streaks (scratches) radiating from the lower peduncle toward the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree interior angle and a narrow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire horizontal boundary; pixel-amplitude peaks are significantly higher and more jagged on the distal thirds of both lobes, particularly the far left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve on the interior trailing edge transitioning to a steep convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast raised white/tan pixel clusters localized on the terminal edge of the right lobe tip, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe and lower-center fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged tissue loss and asymmetrical deformation on the distal tip of the left lobe; concentrated barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) on the right distal tip.
